Based on the visual analysis of the time series plot, there is a distinct anomaly where the values drop significantly below the general trend (which oscillates roughly between -5 and 10). This downward shift occurs after a peak around index 480.

The anomalous range starts approximately at **x = 490** and ends abruptly when the signal jumps back up to the higher level around **x = 530**.

Therefore, the detected range of anomalies is:

[[490, 530]]
